description:
Java SDK for flowd (github.com/krishnakichuu/flowd). A standalone,
    multi-module Maven project — a sibling of flowd-engine (the Go server),
    not nested inside it and not part of its build graph.

    Module layout:
      flowd-sdk-core               framework-agnostic core: annotations,
                                    replay engine, client, worker. The only
                                    module every application depends on.
      flowd-sdk-spring-boot-starter  optional auto-configuration for Spring
                                    Boot, depends on core, adds zero
                                    dependencies to it.
      examples/plain-java           runnable examples with no DI framework.
      examples/spring-boot-worker    consumer half of the Spring Boot
                                    example: runs FlowdWorker, never starts
                                    a workflow itself.
      examples/spring-boot-client    producer half: starts workflow runs
                                    via WorkflowClient, runs no worker.

    See ARCHITECTURE.md for the full design rationale.
